changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.comment: Temporary column that maps a created lecture unit back to the attachment it was created for.

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.comment: Create one attachment video unit per attachment that is attached to a lecture directly.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO lecture_unit (discriminator, name, release_date, lecture_id, lecture_unit_order, migrated_from_attachment_id) SELECT 'A', attachment.name, attachment.release_date, attachment.lecture_id, COALESCE(existing.highest_order, -1) + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY attachment.lecture_id ORDER BY attachment.id), attachment.id FROM attachment LEFT JOIN (SELECT lecture_id, MAX(lecture_unit_order) AS highest_order FROM lecture_unit GROUP BY lecture_id) existing ON existing.lecture_id = attachment.lecture_id WHERE attachment.lecture_id IS NOT NULL AND attachment.attachment_unit_id IS NULL

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM lecture_unit WHERE migrated_from_attachment_id IS NOT NULL

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.comment: Point each migrated attachment at the lecture unit that was created for it.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE attachment SET attachment_unit_id = (SELECT unit.id FROM lecture_unit unit WHERE unit.migrated_from_attachment_id = attachment.id) WHERE attachment.attachment_unit_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lecture_unit unit WHERE unit.migrated_from_attachment_id = attachment.id)

rollback.sql: UPDATE attachment SET attachment_unit_id = NULL WHERE attachment_unit_id IN (SELECT unit.id FROM lecture_unit unit WHERE unit.migrated_from_attachment_id IS NOT NULL)

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.comment: Drop the temporary column now that every migrated attachment names its unit.

rollback.sql: UPDATE lecture_unit SET migrated_from_attachment_id = (SELECT attachment.id FROM attachment WHERE attachment.attachment_unit_id = lecture_unit.id AND attachment.jhi_link LIKE 'attachments/lecture/%') WHERE lecture_unit.discriminator = 'A'
